title: Interactions of elongated dinuclear metallo-cylinders with DNA three-way and four-way junctions.
authors: Dettmer, Samuel J; Stock, Hannah M P; Hannon, Michael J
journal: Journal of biological inorganic chemistry : JBIC : a publication of the Society of Biological Inorganic Chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究延长型双核金属圆柱体与DNA三向/四向连接体的结合机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（配体-DNA）且方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Non-canonical DNA structures play important roles in processing of the genetic code. Three-way (3WJ) and four-way (4WJ) junctions are dynamic, multi-stranded structures containing an open cavity at the centre. We have previously demonstrated that supramolecular dinuclear metallo-cylinders bind well inside 3WJ cavities, having an optimally complementary size and shape match, cationic charge to bind the DNA anion, as well as the ability to pi‑stack with the branchpoint nucleobases. Herein, we show that a longer metallo-cylinder with a similar but extended central pi surface binds to both 3WJ and 4WJ structures with good selectivity over double-stranded DNA. Experimental investigations, informed by molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, reveal that whilst this longer cylinder can bind 3WJs as the previously studied cylinders, the extended pi surface of the cylinder now also facilitates 4WJ binding. The simulations capture two metastable 4WJ conformations -one resembling a 3WJ, and another where the extended length enables the cylinder to angle into and stabilise a rhombus-shaped 4WJ cavity. The ability to tune the structure of supramolecular assemblies is important for targeting different DNA structures with varying specificity, and in this work, we demonstrate the usefulness of overall length as a parameter for modulating DNA binding.
abstract_zh: 非经典DNA结构在遗传密码的处理过程中扮演着重要角色。三向（3WJ）和四向（4WJ）连接点是动态的多链结构，其中心含有一个开放的腔体。我们此前已证明，超分子双核金属圆柱体能够良好地结合在3WJ腔体内，具有最佳互补的尺寸和形状匹配、用于结合DNA阴离子的阳离子电荷，以及与分支点核碱基进行π-堆叠的能力。在此，我们展示了一种更长的金属圆柱体，其具有相似但扩展的中心π表面，能够以对双链DNA的良好选择性结合3WJ和4WJ结构。实验研究结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟揭示，尽管这种更长的圆柱体能够像先前研究的圆柱体一样结合3WJ，但其扩展的π表面现在也促进了4WJ的结合。模拟捕捉到了两种亚稳态的4WJ构象——一种类似于3WJ，另一种则利用其延长的长度使圆柱体倾斜进入并稳定菱形的4WJ腔体。调节超分子组装体结构的能力对于以不同特异性靶向不同DNA结构至关重要，在本工作中，我们展示了整体长度作为调节DNA结合参数的有效性。
